meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 把代码库绘制成按功能分组的流程图，找出跨功能的重复逻辑，提出最简统一架构，并生成每个系统的 /make-plan 移交提示词。不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你要求“找到理想路径”、统一重复的系统，或在重构前审计架构时触发。它总是先做功能发现，边界确认后才展开。

say.text: 用 pathfinder 找出这个代码库的重复逻辑并统一
say.note: 会输出重复报告和统一架构方案

say.text: 重构前用 pathfinder 审计架构，给出统一流程图
say.note: 产物保存在 PATHFINDER-日期 目录里

say.text: 为这些重复模块设计统一入口，并提供 /make-plan 提示词
say.note: 提示词可直接复制给 /make-plan 使用

howto.what_en: Maps a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, spots duplicated concerns, proposes a unified architecture, and hands off /make-plan prompts. It does not write implementation code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to 'find the ideal path', unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. It always runs feature discovery first and waits for boundary approval.

say_en.text: Use pathfinder to find duplicated logic in this repo and unify it.
say_en.note: It produces a duplication report and a unified proposal.

say_en.text: Audit the architecture with pathfinder before refactoring, output a unified flowchart.
say_en.note: Artifacts are saved in a PATHFINDER-<date> folder.

say_en.text: Design one entry point for these duplicated modules and give me a /make-plan prompt.
say_en.note: The prompt can be pasted straight into /make-plan.
